# ClimbUp_1m

- Author: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary2.html

- Source GLB SHA256: 8cee20ab1bc55130092447e810e26df22dd2803eccc54f52137a7d54d7ab88a8

ClimbUp_1m.glb contains only the source skeleton and selected animation; mesh and unrelated animations were removed. The runtime uses a normalized hand/foot trajectory profile extracted from this file, blended with ledge constraints and retargeted through the pet's own arm lengths and foot IK. Root motion is owned by WindowWorld. The original clip lasts 0.667 seconds; the desktop mantle is slowed to 1.6 seconds.

The mouse suspension is procedural (hand constraint + damped pendulum), not a prerecorded VMD. BowlRoll 340609 required login and was not downloaded or included.
